text:
English idiom: as blind as a bat
Meaning: Unable to see well; also used jokingly for failing to notice something obvious.
Example: “I walked past the sign twice; I was as blind as a bat.”

English idiom: the moon is made of green cheese

Example: “You expect me to believe that? Next you'll say the moon is made of green cheese.”

English idiom: a bird in the hand
Meaning: A benefit already secured, as opposed to a speculative better one.
Example: “The small confirmed order was a bird in the hand.”
